text_blocks.snippet: Sweating can be a symptom of a stroke, but it's not always the most prominent or obvious one. Sweating, particularly on one side of the body (hemihyperhidrosis), can occur after a stroke, and is often related to the location and extent of the brain damage. This sweating can be spontaneous or triggered by certain events like exercise or infection.
